note: globalRoot is relative to $HOME (e.g. ".codex/skills" means "$HOME/.codex/skills"). A host installer may override the base (Codex via CODEX_SKILLS_DIR). See packaging/README.md and ADR 0008.

marketplace.note: Claude plugins cannot read files outside the plugin dir, and ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} does not expand in SKILL.md markdown (claude-code issue #9354). The generator must rewrite bare repo-root references to skill-relative paths and bundle referenced content inside the plugin (shared/ dir + per-skill references/ symlinks, dereferenced at install). $ARTIST_OS_ROOT is not usable inside a Claude plugin. See ADR 0008.
